nezPerce.title: Proposed Nez Perce reservation in the Wallowa Valley

nezPerce.dateNote: The archive dates the map to 1873. A related federal text describes a reservation diagram on June 9, 1873, followed by the June 16 executive order. The map image has not independently established an exact drawing date.

rights.statement: The University of Idaho item record identifies the material as public domain and supplies Public Domain Mark 1.0. This is a public-domain designation, not a Creative Commons license imposing attribution conditions. Archive and source credits are retained.

nezPerce.annotation: This federal map outlines a proposed reservation in northeastern Oregon. Its title explicitly names Nez Perce people and the Wallowa Valley; red lines, rivers and survey divisions explain the proposed tract. Read it alongside the government's 1873 order. The map records an administrative proposal rather than the full Nez Perce homeland or present boundaries.

preview.alt: 1873 federal map of a proposed Nez Perce reservation in Oregon's Wallowa Valley, with a red boundary, rivers and survey grid; the archive image clips some outer text and edges.
preview.changes: Original archive-delivered JPEG retained without image alteration. Display the complete available digital frame. The supplied archive image itself clips part of the left title and outer map edges; it is not a complete-sheet scan claim. No generated content.

visualInspection.scope: Actual downloaded 3286 by 2243 archive JPEG inspected visually (tool display resized to 1920 by 1310). Title, red border, Grand Ronde River, West Fork, Wallowa River and survey-grid context read. No unseen manuscript portions claimed.

inspection.scope: Full University of Idaho item record, actual archive JPEG and linked Public Domain Mark read. Related university transcription of the 1873 federal order also read. The original physical NARA document was not inspected. The digital frame has clipped outer content; finer or missing text is not transcribed.

profileLinks.period: 1873 Wallowa Valley proposal and executive-order context
profileLinks.relevance: The image title and archival description explicitly identify the Nez Perce. This offers a narrow reading route into federal treatment of Wallowa Valley land in 1873; it does not represent every Nez Perce community or a present government boundary.
profileLinks.observedMapFeature: NEZ PERCE INDIANS, Wallowa Valley and OREGON in the title; red outlined tract beside labeled rivers and survey divisions.

grandPortage.annotation: A historical map catalogued under Ralph M. Shane and the Grand Portage Band. It offers a community-specific reading route for Grand Portage, Minnesota. The archive labels its region Wisconsin; community and NPS sources place this Grand Portage in Minnesota. The map image remains uninspected.
grandPortage.perspective: Historical map with tribal co-authorship credited by the catalogue
grandPortage.dateNote: Publication year and authorship are catalogue evidence. No independent image transcription or copy-date verification is claimed.

inspection.scope: Read the actual catalogue fields and the Grand Portage Band and NPS community pages. The exact linked archive preview returned HTTP 404. Its generic descriptive summary is not treated as verified image content. Wisconsin catalogue geography conflicts with the community-specific Minnesota evidence; that discrepancy is disclosed.

profileLinks.relevance: The catalogue credits the Grand Portage Band as co-author. Community and NPS sources identify Grand Portage with Ojibwe / Anishinaabe history in Minnesota. This is one community example within the broader directory entry; the map image remains uninspected.
